question: A ring-shaped disc has outer radius 10 cm and inner radius 7 cm. What is the approximate ratio of the ring's area to the whole outer circle?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of ring area to outer circle area = (R² − r²) : R²

⇒ Ratio = (10² − 7²) : 10² = (100 − 49) : 100

⇒ Exact Ratio = 51 : 100

⇒ Approximate Ratio ≈ 50 : 100 = 1 : 2

**∴ The correct answer is 1:2.**
